messages:
Priya: Pushing a compact invite drawer mock for review. Two big questions: show SSO status inline or hide behind an info action, and whether "View changes" should deep-link to Audit Logs or show an inline compact changelog. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-invite-ssoupdate
Owen: My vote: surface SSO status as a non-interactive badge so users aren't confused. If they try to change it, open a modal that explains it's org-scoped and offer a link to settings.
Zara: Agreed. Badge should still be keyboard-focusable and announceable. Use aria-describedby to point to the modal text so screen readers get the full context.
Liam: For role selection, we need clear keyboard affordances: arrow nav for chips, Enter to toggle, and when a role implies SSO show a subtle warning icon next to the chip that opens the modal. Keep primary form controls first in tab order.
Noah: Backend: audit deep-links are supported. We'll accept params (actorId, action=invite, roleId, start, end, source=invite-drawer). We can also return a small array of recent events for an inline summary. Prefer deep-link + small inline preview.
Priya: Copy suggestion for badge tooltip: "SSO enforced for this organization. Change in Organization settings." Badge label: "SSO: enforced (org)". Modal header: "SSO enforcement is organization-wide".
Zara: Accessibility nit: color token for the badge fails at small sizes. Recommend swapping to a darker text token and adding a light background to hit 4.5:1. Also increase focus ring to 3px and make it a visible solid outline.
A11yBot: Auto-scan: current mock fails contrast and lacks aria-live for the toast. Toast must use aria-live="polite" and not steal focus.
Owen: UX for "View changes": show last 4 audit entries inline in the confirmation drawer and include a "See all changes" link that deep-links to Audit Logs with filters applied. That gives quick context without forcing a navigation.
Liam: Toast copy tweak: use "Invites queued — recipients will receive email shortly." Also include a persistent "View invite status" link inside the drawer header for keyboard users (don’t rely on the toast).
Noah: I'll add the deep-link examples to the API docs and a small endpoint that returns the last N audit events for the inline preview. Example: /api/audit?actor=789&action=invite&limit=4&source=invite-drawer.
Priya: Action items: Owen update Figma to show non-interactive badge + modal flow, Zara adjust tokens & focus styles, Liam add keyboard flow and chip ARIA examples to the PR, Noah post deep-link and preview API examples, A11yBot will re-run scan after updates. I'll follow up tomorrow 10am PT to confirm.
Owen: Will update mock and ping here when done.
Zara: I'll post contrast tokens and a small CSS example for the focus ring.
Liam: Adding keyboard/ARIA snippets to PR now.
Noah: Drafting API examples and return-state param patterns.
Priya: Thanks all, closing thread for now unless something blocks the PR. :thumbsup:
